schema:name: Nakanishi et al. (2022) CR Chondrite Metal HSE fs-LA-ICP-MS Spot v1
schema:description: laicpmsTAPP instance derived from Nakanishi et al. 2022 (GCA 319) CR chondrite metal (HSE) Spot analysis fs-LA-Q-ICP-MS Tokyo Institute of Technology (column R of LA-Q_SF-ICPMS_TAPP_v2.xlsx 'TAPP' worksheet).

schema:location.schema:name: Dept. of Earth and Planetary Sciences, Tokyo Institute of Technology, Japan

schema:object: CR chondrite metal grains (interior, margin, and isolated types)
ada:sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrateDefault: In situ — polished epoxy thick section (petropoxy 154 resin, 0.5 µm diamond finish)
ada:samplePreparationMethodDefault: Thick sections in petropoxy 154 resin, polished to 0.5 µm diamond paste, C-coated for EPMA then surface polished before LA
ada:laserManufacturerModel: Cyber Laser IFRIT (Ti:sapphire fs UV laser, 260 nm)
ada:interfaceConeConfiguration: Ni micro-skimmer cone Xs; Ni sampler cone
ada:laserWavelengthAndType: 260 nm Ti:sapphire femtosecond UV; pulse duration ~220 fs (IFRIT system)
ada:carrierGasFlowRateDefault: Carrier gas flow: 0.6 L/min; species not named (carrier gas identity not stated in Table 1 or text)
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: IVB meteorite standards (Warburton Range external + Tawallah Valley secondary) measured alongside unknowns; exact bracketing not described
ada:internalStandardApproach: Single element externally measured by EPMA: ⁶¹Ni concentration from EPMA at exact analysis location used as IS
ada:InternalStandardElement: ⁶¹Ni; concentration from EPMA measured at exact analysis spot location
ada:elementalFractionalCorretion: External calibration using calibration curve method with IVB iron meteorite standards; ⁶¹Ni as IS from EPMA corrects for ablation yield differences between sample and standard
ada:integrationIntervalMethod: Time-resolved signals monitored; analyses with elevated Mg, Si, P, S (inclusion indicators) excluded; stable signal intervals used for integration
ada:backgroundCorrection: Gas blank measured before each spot; background period during single spot transient (rapid intensity rise and decay) used for background correction
ada:isobaricInterferenceCorrection: No explicit corrections applied; monitoring of Mg, Si, P, S used to detect and exclude inclusion-contaminated analyses rather than correct for spectral interferences
ada:interferingSpecies: Sulfide inclusions detectable via ³³S signal; phosphide inclusions via ³¹P; silicate inclusions via ²⁴Mg, ²⁹Si (used to exclude contaminated analyses)
ada:IsobaricInterferenceCorrectionMethod: Exclusion-based approach: analyses with elevated Mg, Si, P, S (from silicate, phosphate, or sulfide inclusions) excluded entirely rather than applying mathematical corrections
ada:calibrationStandardNameDefault: Warburton Range (IVB iron meteorite; Walker et al. 2008) — used as primary external standard and for calibration curve method
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialDefault: Tawallah Valley (IVB iron meteorite; Walker et al. 2008) — measured as secondary/check standard alongside unknowns

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Coupling Description
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: EPMA used to measure Ni concentration at the exact LA-ICP-MS analysis spot location, required for internal standardization of HSE data [Section 2.3]

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Ar make-up: 0.9–1.2 l min⁻¹; Ar auxiliary: 0.6–1.2 l min⁻¹

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Auxiliary and Cool Gas Flow Rates
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Cool gas: 12–13 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.6–1.2 l min⁻¹

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Monitoring of Mg, Si, P, S to check for micro-inclusions (sulfides); analyses with elevated inclusion signals excluded entirely

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: No post-acquisition normalization; calibration curve method using IVB standards provides direct quantification

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Additional Notes
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: fs laser (260 nm Ti:sapphire) essential for HSE measurement in metal (reduces elemental fractionation and matrix effects); IVB iron meteorite standards (Warburton Range + Tawallah Valley) as matrix-matched standards for iron meteorite metal

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Single spot per location (30 µm circular)

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Analyzed constituent
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Analyzed constituent (isotope) identified by the analyte row.
